description: Modern cross-process communication (IPC), RemotePreferences, framework service binding, and hot reload protocols

components.name: io.github.libxposed.service.RemotePreferences
components.summary: Modern secure SharedPreferences implementation communicating with Xposed framework over IPC. Replaces deprecated and non-functional XSharedPreferences on Android 7+.
features: Configured via module UI and broadcasted across processes
Safe across SELinux and scoped storage restrictions

usage.title: Retrieving RemotePreferences in Hooked App
usage.code:
val prefs = getRemotePreferences("settings")
val isEnabled = prefs.getBoolean("feature_flag", false)
prefs.registerOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener { _, key ->
    log(Log.INFO, TAG, "Preference updated: " + key)
}

components.name: io.github.libxposed.service.XposedService
components.summary: Client service class that manages binding and IPC communication with the host Xposed framework service.

components.name: io.github.libxposed.service.HotReloadResult
components.summary: Data holder representing the result and status of dynamic module hot reloading.

interfaces.name: IXposedService

interfaces.name: IHotReloadCallback
interfaces.doc: Callback interface for triggering hot reload notifications.

interfaces.name: HookedProcess
interfaces.doc: Parcelable representing a process that has been hooked by the framework.
